title: to_tsvector regconfig does not work with psycopg3

labels.name: near-term release
labels.description: addition to the milestone which indicates this should be in a near-term release

body:
### Describe the bug

I am not able to specify language configuration when using PostgreSQL full-text search functions (`to_tsvector`, `websearch_to_tsvector`, `plainto_tsvector`) with psycopg3. The cause appears to be sqlalchemy casting the configuration string to `VARCHAR`.

The example is adapted from the tutorial and works as intended with psycopg2 (so does omitting language configuration in psycopg3).

### To Reproduce

```python
import sqlalchemy as sa

url = "postgresql+psycopg://postgres:pgpass@localhost:5432/mydb?sslmode=require"
engine = sa.create_engine(url, echo=True)

metadata = sa.MetaData()

t = sa.Table(
    "BakedGoods", metadata,
    sa.Column("name", sa.Text),
)

t.create(engine, checkfirst=True)

with engine.begin() as con:
    con.execute(t.insert().values(
        [{"name": "Apple pie"}, {"name": "Banana bread"}]))
    goods = con.execute(
        sa.select(t.c.name).where(
            sa.func.to_tsvector('english', t.c.name)\
            .match('apples', postgresql_regconfig='english')
        )
    )

for row in goods.all():
    print(f"Found some apples in {row[0]}")

t.drop(engine, checkfirst=True)
```

### Versions

- OS: Ubuntu 22.04
- Python: 3.11
- SQLAlchemy: 2.0.0b4
- Database: PostgreSQL 14
- DBAPI (eg: psycopg, cx_oracle, mysqlclient): psycopg-3.1.4 (works with psycopg2)


### Additional context

Similar issues:

- https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/issues/6833 is about `asyncpg` support
- https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/issues/6842#issuecomment-908563170 discusses the problem but it sounds like the conclusion is that the issue would not come up, and it does.

If you consider this a duplicate, apologies & feel free to close. I thought it was warranted to report seeing as psycopg3 support was just introduced in the 2.0 beta.
